_comment: The organisation's Actions policy. Only these third-party actions can run in kokeb-labs, besides GitHub-owned actions and anything in kokeb-labs itself, and every action must be pinned to a full commit SHA. Add an entry by pull request with the checklist in org/README.md ('Trying out a new action'); an owner runs kokeb_org.py --apply after merging.

actions.why: Runs markdownlint-cli2, by the author of markdownlint.
clang-format and clang-tidy with PR annotations. Runs hustcer/setup-nu inside, pinned by its own SHA.
Installs Nushell for cpp-linter. Never referenced directly; the version is the one cpp-linter pins.
Downloads the fw-* artifacts of the tagged commit from an earlier run, so a release never rebuilds.
Espressif's own action: runs the build in the espressif/idf image.
Offline and online link checks of the built sites.
Pushes the built site to gh-pages.
The Ruby team's official setup action.
Creates GitHub Releases and uploads their assets.
